text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Tokyo Daishoten.
A year-end race for most, but not for Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes—a brand new beginning. With a fresh mindset from here, a new racing life begins.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Starting next year, I...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm thinking of becoming Tarumae-chan's mentor, you see~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, teaching all kinds of wisdom,
guiding them so~ gently..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"So that I can carry the new era of dirt racing on my shoulders.
What do you think?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I understand what you're trying to say. But...
choice_data_list: I think it's still... too early.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: That's fast. I wonder why?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The one to succeed this era
is not Hokko Tarumae.
The next in line will be—"
choice_data_list: Because Acute is the heir to dirt racing

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Me...? The... successor...?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that must have been her intention.
Yeah, I'm sure that's what she intended.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yes, looking back on it now, the previous champion..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt that was Smart Falcon's intention.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It was beyond what I imagined! I never thought
you'd put on such a dazzling run right beside me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume I've been waiting for all this time must be...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It was you, Acute-san!
Thank you so much for coming all this way to see me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I remember. That embrace in the setting sun
at the Kawasaki Kinen. That was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From Smart Falcon's perspective, perhaps she intended it
as passing the baton.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay. Up until now, I thought I had to
pull everyone forward as troupe leader, but..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because there are girls we can rely on now!
So go to Dubai without any worries!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the message before heading to Dubai was...
addressed to Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon entrusted the future of the dirt racing world
to Wonder Acute, who had begun to make a name for herself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Falco-san is... to me...
choice_data_list: Before we can pass down an era, we must build one first.
Before we can pass down an era, we must build one first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For Wonder Acute herself to take the throne, and keep defending it. Only when that is achieved—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only then will the gates to the next era open.
At an even higher level.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is that... so? It's not just people that we have to support...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
To carry forward the dirt racing world that
Falco-san and our seniors expanded so much,
and connect it to the next era...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: First... I'll take the lead!
choice_data_list: Yeah, Acute! Let's do that thing!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please do!
Let's make it livelier than usual today!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I kinda want it to hit me full force!
Fuhoh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whack, smack, whack!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hyohooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAM, THUD, WHACK WHACK!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Wahoo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SMACKKK!!!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Whooooooo!!!!!!
Let's do this, let's do this, let's do thiiis!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute, brimming with energy.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, oh no! Not like this again!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I'll help with entering the paddock,
Trainer <username>.
Um, Wonder Acute-san...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
You're as full of energy as ever!
Just like the day you debuted.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day I'll learn it all...
Everything from Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And next year, once I reach the Senior class,
I'll become the new center of the dirt track!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Tarumae-chan.
I can't let that slide~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I'm still hale and hearty, you know!
Muho—!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san? Huh?
Huh, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Don't you feel like your mood's been ramping up with every race?
Your eyes are getting sharper and fiercer by the minute...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true. My fighting spirit is top-notch,
and my weight has properly gone down.
As for me, not yet~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm still, still, still so far from—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I can still, still, still, still, still, still, still, still,
still, still, still, still, still runnnn~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And with that...
Hey everyone, folks, ladies and gents!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Make sure to root for meeee~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Wonder Acute!
You're full of energy, aren't ya!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Does she not have limits or what?!
You can do it, Acute!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swirling cheers. Undying strength.
Indeed, it is still too early for a changing of the guard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for an unending silver era—
I accept Hokko Tarumae's challenge.
